en:
Nyahaha! You're so divine, Shuichi!
I haven't had this much fun in a long time!

When I pray to Atua, I'll ask him why I
always have so much fun with you.
Now, let's go back to the dorms together.

Atua says you should spend time with
me again!

Nyahaha! You can only spend time with me!
Atua says so!
Now, let's go back to the dorms together.

Hmmm... You weren't very inspiring today,
Shuichi.

You're normally quite divine...
Does your tummy hurt today?
Well, I'm gonna head back first.

You don't understand anything about
Atua, do you Shuichi?
Atua says he's disappointed in you.
Well, I'm gonna head back first.
